card.line: Beer-lahai-roi is a well in the wilderness south-west of Beersheba, where the Lord met Hagar and where Isaac later lived.

moments.title: Isaac Comes Home
moments.text: Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi, since he was living in the Negev. Early in the evening he went out to the field and saw the camels bringing Rebekah. He took her as his wife and loved her.

moments.title: God Blesses Isaac
moments.text: After Abraham died, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
